image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small turtle resting on a textured green surface (likely artificial turf or moss). The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with distinct longitudinal ridges (keels) and lighter brown margins. Its head is extended, showing greyish skin with faint yellow striping on the neck. One forelimb is visible, appearing stout with small claws. The plastron edge is visible, showing a yellowish/orange hue.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet and sharp claws.
